functions.name: PathTraceScene_Load
functions.note: scene_info.kv3 and scene_meshes.kv3 into the GPU scene: meshes, instances (180094d30), materials (180098660), lights (18008beb0), the ibl (1800999d0), then the upload (180095180)

functions.name: PathTraceScene_AddInstance
functions.note: 0x48-byte instance record: mask = (~material and & instance flags) | material or, packed nMaterialFlags << 16 | instance bits, +0xc the facing-cull-disable byte = material flags & 1; grows the scene bounds

functions.name: PathTraceScene_MaterialFlags
functions.note: from CMaterial2 attributes: doublesided or renderbackfaces -> flags 1; Translucent or alphatest -> 2; mapbuilder.blocklight -> 5; tools.toolsmaterial -> and 1; DoNotCastShadows -> and 0xe (+1 with tools); opaque -> or 0x10 else and 0x10; 0x98bed7f6 -> or 0x20, and 0x11; 0x16458f13 -> or 0x400

functions.name: PathTraceScene_MaterialData
functions.note: per material: an rtx program's block from attribute 0xab672f24's provider; without one, rtx_default_hitgroup's 0x20 bytes: LightSim_Albedo (0x6239512c) clamped 0..0.99 else colour texture LightSim_DiffuseAlbedoTexture (0x0effc516) / RepresentativeTexture (0x5d700411) bindless at +16 (rendersystem vf 0x650, 1, 0xff); opacity 1 at +12, for flag 2 texture 0xfa77b522 at +20 else LightSim_Opacity (0xe2945d83); flags at +24

functions.name: SceneSystem_RtxMaterialNames
functions.note: static names: materials/dev/rtx/binlights, hitgroup_default_opaque (rtx_default_hitgroup combo 0), hitgroup_default_transparent (F_TRANSLUCENT, combo 1), generate_scrambled_halton_samples

functions.name: PathTraceScene_AddLight
functions.note: a scene_info light (barn KV, path_trace_light_flags, baked shadow ids) into PathTraceBarnLightGPU_t (0x1f0 bytes), through 18008c110

functions.name: PathTraceBarnLight_FromShape
functions.note: the LightShape's matrices, colour, radiance factor, cookie, fades and luminaire into the GPU record

functions.name: Luminaire_Area
functions.note: the luminaire's area for the light's PDF

functions.name: LightShape_ReadKV
functions.note: a barn table into the 300-byte LightShape, field by field (m_vInnerRadius +0xa0, m_flShape +0xa8, m_vSkirt +0xac, m_vColor +0xb4, m_flLightColorToRadiance +0xc0, luminaire tables), then the inner radius clamped to 0.9999999

functions.name: PathTraceScene_GeometryInfo
functions.note: a mesh's GeometryInfo_t from its input layout (1804aaf20's, D3D names): position (format 2 or 6, offset 0), normal (6 or 42), tangent (2), texcoords (formats in mask 0x2410010004) and colours (2 or 28) by semantic index, each (offset, format, stream); a field of semantic index -1 takes the D3D name and index of the signature element whose Semantic equals its name

functions.name: PathTraceScene_SetIbl
functions.note: the ibl: SkyTexture (0xa9e45763) as g_tSkyTexture, SkyTextureFormat (0xd5faca7a), SkyBrightnessExposureBias (0xa6413f46, g_flBrightnessExposureBias) scale times exp2

functions.name: SceneGlobalInfoGPU_Construct
functions.note: the 0xC0 globals block at scene +0x3e0: sun irradiance 0, sun min brightness FLT_MAX, IBL scale 1; scene flags |= 1 unless ResourceCompiler/BakedLighting/DisableCullingForShadows

functions.name: PathTraceScene_Upload
functions.note: the scene's buffers and acceleration structures to the GPU: local light bounds = light bounds union clipped to the scene bounds, the bin grid (1804c8280, 0x4000000 bytes, 4 bytes x masks a cell), BRDF LUT bindless slots (scene +0x10 / +0x18), the uploads through 180099c00 (material data, instances 0x20, geometry 0x150 per instance, lights 0x1f0, globals 0xc0), SceneTLAS, RaytraceLightBins (g_binLightsSet)

functions.name: PathTraceScene_UploadStructured
functions.note: (holder, render context, data, stride, count): grows the buffer to count rounded up to 256 (at least 1024) records, then the context's +0x380 upload of stride x count bytes; capture_host.py hooks it

functions.name: LightBinGrid_Size
functions.note: (grid, budget bytes, bytes a cell, min, max): bisects the cell size from (0, largest extent) while the step is over 0.01, counts cvtss2si(extent / size) at least 1, the smaller size kept while count x bytes fits the budget (unsigned)

functions.name: LightShape_ClipBounds
functions.note: the AABB of the clip box corners (x, y in -1, 1; z in 0, 1; order --0, +-0, ++0, -+0, then z 1) through FromClipSpace (+0x40, row major) with the w divide by a reciprocal multiply; minss / maxss from FLT_MAX

functions.name: Quaternion_ToMatrix3x4
functions.note: rows of q = (x, y, z, w) with the translation in column 3: d = 1 - y 2y - z 2z etc., off-diagonals 2y x -+ 2z w (PathTraceBounds.Rotation)

functions.name: Matrix3x4_TransformPoint
functions.note: per row (r3 1 + p.y r1) + (p.z r2 + p.x r0)

functions.name: OrientedBox_Bounds
functions.note: (q, centre, half extents): the eight corners through 18049d6d0 and 18049dd60, AABB from FLT_MAX (18049ddb0)

functions.name: Aabb_Transform
functions.note: a local AABB through a 3 x 4 matrix: centre (max + min) 0.5 transformed, extents (|ey m1| + |ex m0|) + |ez m2| per row

functions.name: Matrix3x4_ScaleRows
functions.note: out[r][c] = s[r] m[r][c]

functions.name: PathTraceScene_ShaderBindingTable
functions.note: 'PathTracingShaderBindingTable': misses Miss0..MissN (1805e9280) per ray type, then per ray type hitgroup_default_opaque:N, hitgroup_default_transparent:N and every material shader's '<shader>:N'

functions.name: SceneUtils_GenerateScrambledHalton
functions.note: ISceneUtils slot 0x1a0, called with the block's pass: PBRT-v3 Halton on a 32 x 32 tile (scales 32 and 81, stride 2592, constants 1377 and 1216) into the 32 x 32 x 128 RG32F volume; permutations from textures/dev/scrambled_halton.vdata

functions.name: CMesh_CreateInputLayout_Thunk
functions.note: 1800912d0's call (flags 0, blend weight limit 4, the material's input signature): CMesh +8 attributes, +0x20 count, to 1804aaf20

functions.name: CMesh_CreateInputLayout
functions.note: per CMesh attribute (0x28: name, name_delta, semantic_index +0x10, offset +0x14, size +0x18, delta +0x1c, no_compression +0x1d): trailing digit = semantic index; format from the attribute table 18066d400 (name +8, index +0x10, format +0x18) else by size (18066d7e0: 0, 41, 16, 6, 2); no_compression takes the size format; a compressed normal is 42 and drops a later tangent; format 0 drops the field; then 1804aa730 with the signature, unmatched fields removed, offsets packed by format size (1805ad07c) per slot

functions.name: InputLayout_MatchSignature
functions.note: per signature element (0xc4: name, Semantic +0x40, D3DSemanticName +0x80, D3DSemanticIndex +0xc0): Semantic through the alias table (+0) or split at a trailing digit picks the layout field (name, index); the result takes the D3D name and index (Semantic kept at +0x2c), identical results once, 16 at most; then PerVertexLighting, LightmapUV, PropWorldOrigin, curvature, bentnormal and blend fields under their table name

functions.name: CMesh_WriteVertexBuffer
functions.note: every vertex, every layout field in order at a running offset through 1804ac280; the tangent pointer from 1804aa130("tangent", 4)

functions.name: CMesh_WriteVertexField
functions.note: blend fields; with a packed normal, CompressTangentFrame (180567b00) of normal and tangent (default 0,0,1,1); pervertexlighting four halves; lightmapuv unorm16 of minss(maxss(x*65535, 0), 65535) truncated; VertexGenericIntegerData raw; TanFrameQuat ((x | 0x400 if w < 0) << 10 | y) << 10 | z, each clamp(-1, 1) * 0.5 + 0.5 times 1023 truncated; else colour from (0,0,0,1) or min(components, size) values through 1804aa4e0 with the format table 1805ad070

functions.name: ConvertFloatToChannel
functions.note: same code as resourcecompiler 181363b90: float (4 bytes copy, 2 bytes 18015e140), unorm clamp 0..1 truncated, int clamp, snorm clamp -1..1 truncated

functions.name: CMesh_FindAttributeOffset
functions.note: first attribute whose name contains the string (V_stristr) with that size (0 any): its offset, else -1

functions.name: Float32ToFloat16
functions.note: same code as resourcecompiler 1802ea750: truncating, saturating at 65504

functions.name: CompressTangentFrame
functions.note: same code as resourcecompiler 182067e80

functions.name: Vector_Basis
functions.note: as resourcecompiler 18125a6c0 (read from both disassemblies): s = n.z >= 0 ? 1 : -1 (NaN -1), a = -1 / (n.z + s); first ((x s) x) a + 1, (x y a) s, -s x; second x y a, (y y) a + s, -y

functions.name: InputSignature_Append
functions.note: appends a material's input signature elements (0xc4 bytes each) to a vector; 1800912d0 takes the mesh's own material (CMesh +0x60 material_name, read at 180091e94)

functions.name: LinearToSrgb8
functions.note: per channel: clamp 0..1, > 0.0031308 ? powf(x, 0.41666666) * 1.055 - 0.055 : x * 12.92, times 255 clamped, rounded; alpha round(a * 255) unclamped

functions.name: CSM_SetupCascades
functions.note: count = min(view +0x38, light desc +0x3e) or csm_max_num_cascades_override (> 0); distances: the light desc's +0x48 (each later one doubled from the last given), csm_cascadeN_override_dist (> 0), the practical split ((V_powf(M/n, k/N) n - lin) 0.85 + lin) + 0.1 from n = max(0.125, frustum near), then the view attributes 0x61fac369, 0x70644345, ... replace each (1804976e5 on); M = csm_max_shadow_dist_override (> 0, view flag bit 4 clear) else ShadowFarZ (0x7b2a64e1, default 1000) at most the frustum far (+0x24 of the frustum at r8 +0x18); CubemapShadowCascades.SplitDistances / MaxDistance

functions.name: CSM_FitCascade
functions.note: a fit's cascades (light view, ortho, snapped bounds; CubemapShadowCascades.Fit) and their culling: per cascade the shadow view (1804a7a60), the previous cascade's ortho pulled 15% in as six planes with d negated (first culling-box set, +0x174 count 6), the fit's caster volume (180495df0, up to 12, d negated) as the second set (+0x170); AggregateCulling.CascadeFrustum

functions.name: CSM_ShadowViewFrustum
functions.note: a cascade's frustum object: camera = translation of the inverted view (180498c70), planes from projection x (view x translate(camera)) through 180498520 with the zero-to-one flag, packed by 18049bcb0; CubemapShadowCascades.Camera, AggregateCulling.CascadeFrustum

functions.name: CSM_CasterVolume
functions.note: the sun's caster volume from the main view's inverse world-to-projection corners and the corners pushed by light x reach: back-facing planes, the cap (1.125 x the double running minimum), silhouette edge planes (1805ab720 / 1805ab738), none when the centroid is outside or fewer than 6; AggregateCulling.CasterVolume

functions.name: Matrix4_Invert
functions.note: the client's 181747070 (Gauss-Jordan with row pivoting); AggregateCulling.Invert4

functions.name: Frustum_PackPlanes
functions.note: scenesystem's copy of client 1817435e0

functions.name: VectorNormalize
functions.note: times 1 / sqrt((y y + z z) + x x) within [1e-17, 1e17]; CubemapShadowCascades.Normalize

functions.name: Aggregate_CullView
functions.note: CAggregateSceneObjectDesc vfunc 0x38: a world aggregate in one view (CPU). Fragments in order (desc +0x194), or with sc_aggregate_bvh (18089cf98) and a BVH (+0x1c8, built above sc_aggregate_bvh_threshold 128) its nodes against the view's 8 planes (+0x460, camera +0x430), each surviving fragment through 18003d380 into the visible list (per-view data +0x30); then one 0x20-byte instance record per visible fragment at the view's instance block (an atomic counter, so block order follows thread timing). The +0x34/+0x38 draw slots it assigns serve the GPU-driven path, not DrawArray; Cubemaps/AggregateCulling.cs

functions.name: Aggregate_CullFragment
functions.note: one fragment: the frustum p-vertex test ((px nx + py ny) + pz nz < d on the camera-relative box), the culling boxes (view +0xf34), the LOD test (+0x22 setup, +0x24 mask, 1800450f0), the per-view PVS (FUN_180036840), the small-object fade; the size metric (18004c390) into the per-view record +0; appends the fragment when visible; AggregateCulling.Outside / Visible

functions.name: AggregateDesc_DrawArray
functions.note: vfunc 0x8: per draw primitive (0x70) its (fragment, visible position) list; fragment count = transform count: consecutive positions on one draw call become one instanced command; else a command per entry extended while the transform slot (+0x20) is the first's and the next first index continues the range (sc_aggregate_fragment_merging 18089cf28); first instance = view block + position; commands appended to desc +0x68 (20 bytes each); AggregateCulling.Commands

functions.name: AggregateDesc_LayerFragmentList
functions.note: one layer's (fragment, position) list from the visible list in order: layer flag masks on fragment +0x14, the layer's plane test (+0xc08..+0xc14), then the size split on layer +0x6d0 (positive: keep size >= it; negative: keep min(size, aggregate size) < -it); +0x20 the largest size times +0x44 (the primitive's 16-bit sort key); AggregateCulling.InLayer

functions.name: CAggregateSceneObject_AddFragment
functions.note: vfunc 0x28 (worldrenderer 18001e920 per AggregateMeshInfo_t): a transform slot (0x38 each at +0x150) unless the last slot has the same base vertex (draw +0x54), packed tint (18049ca70 then 18049c8d0) and transform within 1e-5 (18049ad90); the 0x50-byte fragment record (+0x14 flags, +0x16 meshlets, +0x18 draw call, +0x1c index count, +0x20 slot, +0x22 LOD setup, +0x24 LOD mask, +0x28 tint); bounds (+0x180, 0x20 each) the draw's bounds through 18049bfb0 when it has meshlets, radius 0.5 sqrt((dz dz + dy dy) + dx dx); AggregateCulling.Fragments

functions.name: CAggregateSceneObject_Setup
functions.note: vfunc 0x30: above sc_aggregate_bvh_threshold (18089cfa8) builds tinybvh (1804c9ad0, c_trav 16, c_int 1) over the fragment bounds and reorders fragments and bounds into left-first leaf order; AggregateCulling.CullOrder

functions.name: TinyBvh_BuildCustomAabb
functions.note: tiny_bvh.h BVH::Build(customGetAABB, count): root bounds, then 1804c87c0 (the same build as resourcecompiler's 181ed64a0); Lighting/TinyBvh.cs

functions.name: Matrix3x4_TransformPoint
functions.note: through 18049c3a0: x' = (y m1 + m3) + (x m0 + z m2); AggregateCulling.TransformPoint

functions.name: View_SphereScreenSize
functions.note: clamp(r cot rsqrtss((dy dy + dx dx) + dz dz), 0, 1), 1 inside the sphere; orthographic views 2r / height; AggregateCulling.ScreenSize

functions.name: Aggregate_SelectLods
functions.note: per LOD setup (0x34 bytes): size as 18004c390 with the setup's scale, f = 50 / (size x view height), the highest LOD whose switch distance is below f; cross-fade bytes under the LOD fade convars; AggregateCulling.SelectLod

functions.name: AggregateDesc_OnBeginRenderingFrame
functions.note: per aggregate: fragment draw slots +0x34/+0x38 to -1, +0x210/+0x214 from +0x1fc/+0x200, the transform block +500 to -1

functions.name: AggregateDesc_UploadDraws
functions.note: vfunc 0x50: uploads the frame's indirect commands (desc +0x68, count +0x60, 20 bytes each) to the buffer at +0x80

functions.name: Frustum_PlanesFromMatrix
functions.note: scenesystem's copy of client 1817465f0; the cascade fit calls it with the zero-to-one flag

functions.name: CSM_SetupForView
functions.note: calls 180496ef0 with the frustum at view +0x10 (or vfunc 0x240's +0x10 under view flag bit 0xc), copied with +0x18 replaced by a view attribute when non-zero
